ruling.explanation:
To the rider: your $8.00 no-show fee was correctly charged and stands. Your account that the driver never came is contradicted by the record of this trip. The GPS trace shows the vehicle holding position at The Interlace Main Guardhouse — the pickup pin — continuously for 585 seconds (9 min 45 s), from 16:02:10 to 16:11:55, against a 300-second minimum for a large-venue pickup, with 60 position fixes inside the 120 m arrival radius. The trip record shows the driver marked arrival at 16:02:25 and cancelled only at 16:12:10, after that hold elapsed, on the code RIDER_NO_SHOW. He messaged you twice (16:02:40 and 16:07:15), you replied 'coming coming 2 min' at 16:08:02, he answered 'ok no problem' 18 seconds later, and the in-app call he placed at 16:09:40 was answered for 34 seconds — so you were reachable. Your own device, meanwhile, never left the spot about 640 m inside the estate. None of the rider-protective clauses helps you: POL-NS-04 fails because the driver replied well within 120 seconds and telephoned you, and because your device was never inside the 150 m presence radius; POL-NS-05 fails because the driver was stationary at the pin, not 300 m away or in motion; POL-NS-06 fails because a 585-second hold is a surplus, not a shortfall. The $8.00 is the correct figure under the fee schedule — the greater of the large-venue zone fee ($4.00) and the RYDE_XL vehicle-tier fee ($8.00). I have noted your request for someone to call you; no clause of the policy provides for that, so it is not a step this ruling can order.

To the driver: your fee was earned and you are paid. Arrival, the 585-second in-geofence dwell and the RIDER_NO_SHOW termination are all made out under POL-NS-01, and nothing in POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces them, so POL-NS-07 compensates you at 80% of the $8.00 fee — SGD 6.40, charged to the platform and never recovered from the rider. The anti-farming check does not bite: 2 no-show terminations in 30 days is below the threshold of 4, and the rate against 143 completed trips is about 0.014, far below 0.08.

To both parties: the absent traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-00208-01, weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) does not affect this outcome, and both advocates correctly disclosed it. The rider's profile history played no part — only this trip's record decided the case. No clause on these facts produces a referral.
